name: Finance Bot
tagline: Turns a business inbox into a running ledger and a month-end profit figure
description: It reads a company mailbox without write access, watching for money coming in and going out, and appends each finding as a row in a Google Sheets ledger. Month-end brings a profit-and-loss statement built from those rows, and adding rows is the only change it can make.
author: johnboyle
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
